title: Fourier weight of a homogeneous function
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ have all its nonzero Fourier coefficients supported on subsets of cardinality $k$, where $k$ is a natural number. Then the total Fourier weight of $f$ at level $k$ equals the square of its uniform $L^2$ norm.
hypotheses_covered: Every nonzero Fourier coefficient of $f$ is indexed by a subset of size $k$
